name: Survodutide
description: Experimental injected peptide (BI 456906) that acts on two hormone receptors: glucagon and GLP-1

note.lead: Heart trial results not yet published.
note.text: A heart-safety trial of about 5,500 people reached primary completion in June 2026; Phase 3 MASH trials are recruiting.

bullets: **Acts on two hormone receptors:** glucagon and GLP-1
**Given once a week** under the skin in trials
**Brain appetite areas** studied in mice and lab work
**No FDA label,** so there is no approved mechanism statement

practical.routes: Injection under the skin, once weekly (trials)
practical.soldAs: Not approved; FDA warned “research use” sellers
practical.monitored: Weight, HbA1c, liver biopsy, stomach and bowel effects
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; S0 status unconfirmed

regulatory.text: Not named; class S0 may apply

references: le Roux et al., SYNCHRONIZE-1, N Engl J Med, Aug 2026
Sanyal et al., survodutide Phase 2 in MASH, N Engl J Med, Jul 2024
FDA, Concerns with unapproved GLP-1 drugs used for weight loss, Oct 2026
